Camille gets hold of the dagger and brings it to Jarrod. The winds of fate are about to change.

Wes sends the team back to the future. Now it's up to Wes and Eric to resolve their issues, and defend the city. In the future, the Rangers discover what happened to the city and their friend. Rocky's strange botany experiment, a plant that eats metal, and Skull's own one made from swiping part of his, get turned into a pair of Plant Monsters by the Machine Empire. One of which, the Pollenator, sprays its creator with a pollen that causes Rocky to turn into a living vegetable!
When a movie star comes to town, the Rangers' secret identities are unexpectedly threatened.

The others don't believe him and try to tell him that all that matters is destroying Dai Shi.

The Power Rangers fight across dimensions to try and rescue Princess Shayla from the returning Master Org.
When Tyler's Energem is cracked, he must dig deep into the earth to mend it with the extreme heat of lava.

Adam trains Carlos to try and get his confidence back.

Artillicon attack again, the Rangers attack backfires on them resulting in them reverting to their civilian identities.
